0x1070be21.name: prepare_subtree_operands
0x1070be21.comment: Recurses over src operands, and over the base/index of memory operands. Children that must stay separate are simplified as their own roots (0x1070bc39), the rest recursively.

0x1070be5b.name: tuple_unlink_mem_subops

0x1070bf4c.name: simplify_expression_tree

0x1070c148.name: build_nary_expression_tree
0x1070c148.comment: Forward-substitutes single-def temps into the use (via 0x1070bd4e), inserts 0x15f for type mismatches, rewrites int a-b as a+(-b), and flattens nested same-op commutative nodes into n-ary nodes.

0x1070c2d5.name: simplify_tree_bottom_up
0x1070c2d5.comment: Children first (and, when factoring is on, 0x15f children via 0x1071e6ba), then 0x1070c389 + 0x1070cff9. With factoring on, or for 0x17d, also 0x1070d47f + 0x1070d7dd.

0x1070c389.name: simplify_node_algebraic
0x1070c389.comment: Algebraic rules per opcode: identity/annihilator constants, x+(-x), &a-&b, ~~x, ~(-x), (a*b)<<c, float x/c -> x*(1/c) (/Op off), x/2^k -> shr, unsigned x%2^k -> and, shift chains, compare/select folding.

0x1070cf89.name: is_unary_il_opcode

0x1070cfaf.name: simplify_tree_final_stage
0x1070cfaf.comment: Third loop body: widening-conversion pushdown (0x1070dce4), recursion, 0x1070df28 distribution, 0x1070c389, fold.

0x1070cff9.name: fold_constant_operands
0x1070cff9.comment: Folds pairs of int constants (0x1070693c) or float constants (0x10708733). Folds &sym + const into the symbol piece (0x10703ba0) when not -dlp and the offset lies inside the object.

0x1070d234.name: distribute_and_propagate
0x1070d234.comment: Replaces temps defined by an 0x15b copy with the copy source (0x10743352). Pushes neg/conv/shift/and/or/mul/shl through their operands (0x10710053) and repeats on change.

0x1070d47f.name: factor_common_terms
0x1070d47f.comment: Reverse distribution (factor.c-style): a*c+b*c -> (a+b)*c, and/or/xor common terms, compare+shift rewrites (0x17d), bitfield-merge pattern (0x1070f3c7).

0x1070d7dd.name: refresh_node_cost_shallow
0x1070d7dd.comment: Recomputes one node's packed cost from existing child costs and re-sorts commutative operand lists.

0x1070d90c.name: compute_tree_cost_and_sort
0x1070d90c.comment: Recursive: leaf costs; subtrees reached through temp defs or memory base/index take their def tree's cost; stable descending sort of commutative operand lists; node cost = hash|pack. SIB consequence (sib-operand-order.md): the first operand of an address sum becomes the SIB base. A load whose address is still an expression temp (e.g. p+0x5c not CSE-available) takes the address tree's cost (need>=1) and always sorts first; a load through a symbol (CSE temp or local) is a leaf, hash (fold(disp)+7+(hash(base)<<8))&0xffff. Trace-verified in traverse_path_follow_golb and Hill/Valley.

0x1070da9a.name: pack_expression_cost
0x1070da9a.comment: Cost = (need<<24)|(size<<16)|hash16. Leaf: size 1 (0 for constants), need 0. Node: size = 1+sum(child size), need = running max with +1 on ties (order dependent), +7 for kind 0xe and +5 for kind 0x12.

0x1070db59.name: hash_operand
0x1070db59.comment: 16-bit hash by operand kind (byte table 0x1070e800 -> jump table 0x1070e7e0). Symbol kinds 1/2: v=id>>16^id&0xffff, ((v&0x7ff)<<5)^((v<<5)>>16); class-3 temp without def: id<<6; temp with def: def tree hash; kind 3: folded id. Kind 4 code address (callee/label): xor-fold of the frontend record id fe+0x28, a TU-wide declaration counter. Memory: fold(disp)+addrform-0x145+hash(base)<<8. Constants: value fold. Kinds 0xa/0xb: 0. Tuple: (sum(child<<(i&7)) + opcode-0x145) truncated to 16 bits, so a call's hash = (callee + 2*(arg+0x15) + 0x3f) mod 0x10000 and can wrap. Trace-verified on read_repeating_text_input_key_code (snail): keys 0x080501f3/0x080509b3 at fe id 0x10a, 0x0805fbe0/0x080503e0 at 0xfb37.

0x1070dce4.name: widen_conversion_pushdown
0x1070dce4.comment: Pushes a widening int conversion (result <=4 bytes, but not to 16 bits) below neg/add/and/or/xor/shift, so the arithmetic is done at the wider type.

0x1070df28.name: distribute_before_final

0x1070df74.name: rebuild_subtractions

0x1070e114.name: emit_tree_as_tuples
0x1070e114.comment: Re-linearizes an n-ary tree into binary tuples before g_simplify_insert_before (left-deep chain over sorted operands; call args reversed = right-to-left). Sethi-Ullman: for is_reorderable_binary_opcode nodes whose type class is not 0x4000 (float), if compare_operand_cost_desc(A,B) > 0 (key(B) > key(A), unsigned) B's subtree is emitted first; operand order is kept, so cmp A,B keeps its direction. Call sites 0x1070e320 (substituted node) and 0x10792d4a (materialized root). Calls are tree-substituted, so this orders f(a)==f(b); the post-globopt run (optimize_expression_trees mode 2) is final. Trace-verified (scripts/c2/su_order_trace.py).

0x1070f0c7.name: factor_out_common_operand

A bare constant term counts as 1*c: x*4+4, 4*x+4, x*4+1*4 and x/0.25+4 all become (x+1)*4 (verified: returns 1 from factor_common_terms at 0x1070d4ca, in optimize_expression_trees mode 1 before globopt). Collects call sites with inline_collect_call_sites, and for each: checks size (fe+0x6d <= 0x28 or budget) and the global cap 35000 (g_inline_total_size), warns C4710/C4714 (warning(4, 0x2c6 + 4*forceinline)) or C4711 (0x2c7), reads the callee IL (read_function_il), binds address-constant actuals (0x1075bdb3/0x1075d816/0x1075d889), recurses into the callee body with depth+1 (callsite 0x1071888b), substitutes formals (inline_substitute_formals, callsite 0x10718940) and splices the body in place of the call. Traced: vector-constructor-iterator arrays expand at depths 2 (??_H) and 3 (element ctor).

0x1072385a.name: find_tuple_of_kind

0x10723976.name: operand_new_hardreg

Deletes tuples after a terminator until a label/0x15/0x18; branches are kept after a ret
when fn+0x34&0x10000 or symbol flag 0x1000. Returns count.

0x10723a32.name: tuple_new_binary

0x10723e43.name: invert_branch_over_jump

0x10723f00.name: try_substitute_operand

0x10724028.name: set_flags_effects
0x10724028.comment: Annotates EFLAGS (0x107adcd8) def/use operands per opcode (tables 0x10724168/0x1072417c); jcc/setcc reads flags.

0x107242ea.name: operand_list_find_reg

0x10724305.name: emit_load_into_register

0x107249b8.name: insert_live_range_reload
0x107249b8.prototype: c2_tuple* __fastcall insert_live_range_reload(c2_symbol* sym, void* home, c2_tuple* where)

0x10724a85.name: free_live_range
0x10724a85.comment: color.c 5601: frees allowed set, optionally unlinks from colour queue, unhashes, memsets, keeps id, pushes on free list.

0x10724b00.name: operand_list_has_same_reg
0x10724b00.comment: True if the list has another kind-1 operand with the same storage as the head.

0x10724b25.name: score_live_ranges
0x10724b25.prototype: void __fastcall score_live_ranges(c2_function* fn, int reg_class, c2_bitset* candidates)
0x10724b25.comment: Per block: benefit += w*saving per ref, -= w*cost per reload/spill; priority += P*w*S if referenced else -= P*w; allowed -= busy/explicit/clobbered regs; builds copy preferences. w=1<<depth under /Ot.

0x1072547e.name: bitset_intersects
0x1072547e.comment: True if two sparse bitsets share a set bit.

0x107254dc.name: load_saving
0x107254dc.comment: /Ot: 2 non-constant, 1 constant. /Os: bytes of a separate load (6 abs, 3+ebp_alloc stack, 2..5 immediates).

0x107254f6.name: can_use_memory_operand
0x107254f6.comment: Opcode-table driven: whether this reference could be encoded as a memory operand of the tuple (selects 0x10725751 vs 0x107254dc).

0x10725751.name: memory_operand_saving
0x10725751.comment: /Ot: non-constant 2. Constant: other operand = dst if g_x86_op_flags bit 0x800 (pure-destination op, e.g. mov), else src[0] (push: the constant itself); cmp X,0 -> 0; other kind 2 -> 1; kind 6 with direct symbol or nonzero disp -> 1; else 0 (and a physical-register partner gets +0x11|=0x80). /Os: bytes of memory-operand encoding (4 absolute, 1+ebp_alloc stack).

0x107257e9.name: add_register_preference
0x107257e9.comment: Adds or increments (+1) a {next,reg,weight} preference unless the range is already coloured.

0x1072583c.name: unlink_scoring_list
0x1072583c.comment: Removes a range from a +0x14-linked scoring list.

0x107258da.name: live_range_from_id
0x107258da.comment: Hash lookup by id; ICE if missing.

0x10725ab9.name: is_lea_of_live_ranges
0x10725ab9.comment: lea with single dst whose base/index are live ranges.

0x10725b42.name: prune_low_use_live_ranges
0x10725b42.comment: Ranges with <2 refs (unless benefit>0 and def is a reload) are demoted (0x10725eed); 2-ref load ranges folded (0x10725c27); removed from candidate sets; recomputes last-use flags.

0x10725c27.name: fold_two_ref_load_range
0x10725c27.comment: mov lr,[mem] with a single use that accepts a memory operand: substitute memory operand, delete the load.

0x10725ed6.name: tuple_get_block_nonnull
0x10725ed6.comment: Walk back to the nearest block boundary whose block pointer is set.

0x10725eed.name: demote_live_range
0x10725eed.comment: Deletes its reloads/spills and turns references back into memory/local-temp form; frees the range.

0x10726230.name: find_block_exit_insert_point
0x10726230.comment: Last position in a block before its terminating branch (skips 0x1b markers); updates current line globals.

0x1072639d.name: defer_live_range
0x1072639d.comment: Moves a range behind the other deferred (+5 bit 0x40) ones, ordered by benefit; constants last.

0x10726481.name: split_edge_with_new_block
0x10726481.comment: Creates a new block on a pred->succ edge and redirects the branch.

0x10726654.name: globopt_fold_adjacent_copies
0x10726654.comment: 0x15d->0x15b; t=expr immediately followed by x=t folds into x=expr (0x10726b1b / 0x10726bfe)

0x107266ff.name: globopt_finalize_tuples
0x107266ff.comment: 0x169->0x15b, deletes x=x, aggregates back to 0x16b, normalizes constant operand types, clears operand +0x11 bit 7

0x10726cd5.name: operand_new_addr
0x10726cd5.comment: Kind-5 address expression (LEA form): mode op, type, +0x20 sym, +0x24 disp, +0x28 base, +0x2c index.

0x10726d75.name: build_live_ranges
0x10726d75.comment: color.c web builder: numbers candidates, block liveness, webs; rewrites placeholder kind-1 operands to c2_live_range*; tie key +0x40 = def-tuple ordinal.

0x10726fc6.name: solve_block_liveness
0x10726fc6.comment: Iterative dataflow: +0x44 live-out = union succ +0x40; +0x40 live-in = use | (out - def).

0x1072707a.name: compute_block_local_sets
0x1072707a.comment: Backward per-block walk: block +0x2c referenced, +0x30 upward-exposed uses, +0x34 defs (candidate indices).

0x107276eb.name: remove_duplicate_edges
0x107276eb.comment: Deletes a second succ edge to the same destination.

0x10727731.name: duplicate_exit_block_into_predecessors
0x10727731.comment: fg.c 7499, /Ot only: copies the label-led exit block tail (<=2 real tuples, no call/0x15) to the end of each predecessor if preds*len<=8.

0x1072795a.name: promote_immediates_to_candidates
0x1072795a.comment: Walks real tuples in IL order. First scans dsts: a dst narrower than 4 bytes (kind 1 with placeholder home, or kind 2) that is a part of a larger symbol and not class 3 marks the root partially written (root+5 |= 0x80). Then each kind-7 source allowed by 0x10727e73, and each symbol/code address outside call/branch tuples, is replaced by a constant-symbol operand (0x10727f41) that keeps the immediate's type (a byte store makes the value's range byte-only). lea is skipped. Returns count+1.

0x10727bd3.name: assign_candidate_indices
0x10727bd3.comment: Gives each promotable symbol a 0x18-byte candidate info at sym+0x30 with a running index. A part narrower than 4 bytes normally gets no index: +0x34 points at the smallest containing part (usually the root) and its references are tracked as that symbol. If the root is marked partially written (+5&0x80, from 0x1072795a) each part gets its own index; the mark is cleared afterwards.

0x10727e73.name: tuple_allows_constant_candidate
0x10727e73.comment: Refuses: mov R,0 / cmp R,0 only when R is a kind-1 operand with a physical-register home (home class != 2; the candidate placeholder 0x107ae040 has class 2, so mov candidate,0 is allowed); add/sub with esp/ebp dst; enter, imul (6, 0xa3, 0xc1), ret, in, out, rcl..shr (0x25..0x2b), shld/shrd, 0x11a, 0x166, 0x178. Everything else (push, xchg, and/or/xor/test, stores) is allowed. Table 0x10728190/0x107281a0.

0x10727f41.name: make_constant_candidate_operand
0x10727f41.comment: One class-0xd symbol per distinct value (hash g_constant_symbol_hash[value%64]); creates its live range immediately; operand -> placeholder home.

0x107281cd.name: pass_narrow_byte_lanes
0x107281cd.comment: Pass: backward tuple walk calling narrow_byte_lane_tuple; turns (x>>8)&0xff / x&0xff / shifts by 8 into byte-subregister (AL/AH-style) operands.

0x10728217.name: narrow_byte_lane_tuple
0x10728217.comment: For <=4-byte int tuples, inspects temp sources defined by IL 0x16d/0x173 (add/or), 0x171/0x177 (shl/shr by 8), 0x172 (and 0xff), 0x17d (cmp); rewrites via make_byte_lane_operand.

0x107284d8.name: pass_mark_register_candidates
0x107284d8.comment: Pass (effective only with /Og): kind-2 symbol operands that are not volatile (operand/symbol flag 0x40), not class 0xa, of register-able type (0x107059e2), not a call target and not float get placeholder home 0x107ae040.

0x10728587.name: pass_form_read_modify_write
0x10728587.comment: Pass: for IL copy 0x15b whose destination is not a single-def temp, calls form_read_modify_write.

0x107285f0.name: pass_sizeopt
0x107285f0.comment: Pass (sizeopt.c): clears per-symbol width info, then sizeopt_block on every block.

0x1072865c.name: sizeopt_block
0x1072865c.comment: Iterates forward|backward width scans to a fixpoint (ICE sizeopt.c:69 after 50 rounds); without /Ot also runs sizeopt_narrow_to_word.

0x10728696.name: sizeopt_forward_scan
0x10728696.comment: Removes redundant zero-extensions (IL 0x15f from 0x2001/0x2002) and and-masks when the source is known narrow (symbol +0x31 >= 0x18/0x10); records width facts (+0x32 bits 1/2); splits >4-byte mul (0x1076a588).

0x10728a34.name: sizeopt_backward_scan
0x10728a34.comment: Propagates known-zero high bits (+0x31) from narrow uses; narrows ops to byte width or widens sub-dword ops to dword when legal (can_change_op_width + op_supports_width -> set_op_width).

0x10728ee5.name: pass_remove_redundant_branches
0x10728ee5.comment: Pass: repeats remove_redundant_branches_once until it reports no change.

0x10728f00.name: remove_redundant_branches_once
0x10728f00.comment: Per block: deletes unreferenced labels, jmp-to-next, branches whose target label directly follows; with /Og also 0x10723e43.

0x1072906a.name: pass_if_convert
0x1072906a.comment: Pass (always runs): each conditional branch (kind 0x11, cond != 0 or IL 0x18b) not pinned (+9&8) -> try_if_convert_diamond.

0x107290aa.name: pass_strength_reduce_mul_div
0x107290aa.comment: /Og pass: IL 0x16f mul by const (int, not 64-bit) -> expand_mul_by_constant; IL 0x175 div by const (/Ot only, non-pow2, <=4 bytes) -> expand_div_by_constant. Modulo 0x176 is NOT handled (stays idiv).

0x107291bd.name: init_mul_decomposition_cache
0x107291bd.comment: Clears memo hash 0x1079e894 (511 buckets) and seeds 1(op0),-1(neg),2,4,8(scale),3,5,9(lea) with costs from 0x107ae0b8.

0x107292a8.name: mul_decomp_lookup
0x107292a8.comment: Hash lookup/insert of decomposition node {next, value, cost(500=unknown), op, chain}.

0x1072930f.name: pass_select_address_modes
0x1072930f.comment: Pass (addr.c): backward walk; folds single-def temp defs into memory operands (dst first, then src0/src1) and turns 0x15b copies of kind-5 address operands into lea.

0x107294f3.name: pass_merge_return_tails
0x107294f3.comment: Runs only when /Ot is off: for jumps to the exit label, finds identical instruction runs before them (tuple compare 0x1070e8ba), routes differing return values through one new temp and shares the common tail (cross-jumping).

0x10729511.name: pass_lower_function
0x10729511.comment: Pass: lowers every non-arg tuple (IL 0x15a/0x16a deferred to their call) via lower_tuple, then per tuple: propagate_lowered_copy, set_flags_effects, deletes 0x145 nops, rewrites 0x148/0x14c operands.

0x107296be.name: reset_lowering_state
0x107296be.comment: Clears x87 stack model (0x10799040, depth 0x1079903c=-1) and 0x107ac14c.

0x107296de.name: assign_parameter_homes
0x107296de.comment: Walk param list at function entry, home params (fsym+0x42 = total param bytes, used by ret N); non-/Og register params get stack homes.

0x107298d7.name: prepend_entry_frame_operand
0x107298d7.comment: Prepends a 0x14a operand for function-context +4 to the entry tuple.

0x10729904.name: first_param_offset
0x10729904.comment: 8 normally; 0xc when function flag 2, or flag1 clear and 0x107ac324 > 8.

0x1072992b.name: mark_params_needing_memory
0x1072992b.comment: Marks params referenced through memory/address operands (symbol +0x14 |= 0x100).

0x107299e4.name: param_list_contains
0x107299e4.comment: Helper over the entry param list; with arg4 clears flag 0x100 on candidates.

0x10729b36.name: is_foldable_memory_operand
0x10729b36.comment: Kind-6 memory operand, not form 0x152, size <=4 and !=3 (and -dlp flags clear).

0x10729b6e.name: lower_tuple
0x10729b6e.comment: Lower one tuple: float -> 0x10762fc3, else lower_int_tuple + 0x1072289e.

0x10729c3c.name: lower_int_tuple
0x10729c3c.comment: Integer lowering: IL op -> x86 op (switch on op-0x15a).

0x1072a632.name: propagate_lowered_copy
0x1072a632.comment: For mov t1<-t2/const/mem (kind-1 dest): substitutes into later uses (try_substitute_operand) and turns the copy into nop 0x145.

0x1072aa3c.name: can_change_op_width
0x1072aa3c.comment: Checks an op can be evaluated at width w (per-opcode table 0x1072beac; operands readable at w).

0x1072ab94.name: operand_readable_as_dword
0x1072ab94.comment: mov edx,4 then falls into operand_readable_at_width; used by the /Ot zero-extension choice.

0x1072ab99.name: operand_readable_at_width
0x1072ab99.comment: Operand can be read with width w: temps/consts yes; memory only if the wider access stays inside the symbol and alignment <= /Zp (0x107ac0f4) and not volatile.

0x1072ac94.name: fold_address_expression
0x1072ac94.comment: Absorbs defs (0x15b copy, 0x16d add, 0x16e sub, 0x16f mul by 1/2/4/8, 0x171 shl by 1..3) into base/index/scale/disp/symbol; final form 0x146..0x14f; for non-memory adds chooses lea vs add/sub/shl (two-address when dest == base).

0x1072c01b.name: assign_register_argument
0x1072c01b.comment: assign next free reg from list: conv 4/0x18 -> {ECX,EDX} (0x107ac140), else (0x14) {ECX} (0x107ac148); only 1/2/4-byte int types; used for callee params (arg5=1) and call args

0x1072c246.name: operand_new_temp_in_reg
0x1072c246.comment: Fresh temp symbol pre-bound to hard register n (kind 1).

0x1072c275.name: lower_pending_arg_copies
0x1072c275.comment: lowers the 0x15a/0x16a argument definitions feeding a call/intrinsic before the call itself (non-float)

0x1072c2e5.name: pass_machine_peephole
0x1072c2e5.comment: /Og pass after lowering: fold_single_use_loads on every tuple; shr after and-mask drops the and; add/sub +-1 -> inc/dec (unless flags consumed); cmp -> eliminate_compare_with_zero.

0x1072c4d7.name: fold_single_use_loads
0x1072c4d7.comment: If a source temp is defined by mov from memory with a single use and no intervening conflict, folds the memory operand into the instruction.

0x1072c5bf.name: can_fold_source_load
0x1072c5bf.comment: Source temp single-def, not in multi-op 0x166 / kinds 0x13/0x14, not flagged 0x20.

0x1072c60d.name: is_simple_load
0x1072c60d.comment: mov with single dest and plain memory source.

0x1072c730.name: form_read_modify_write
0x1072c730.comment: x = x op y (add/sub/and/or/xor/shifts; sub folded as add with negation flag) -> op [x], y memory-destination form; 8-byte only for xor.

0x1072c92e.name: materialize_memory_sources
0x1072c92e.comment: Inserts mov temps for kind-6 memory sources of a def before folding it.

0x1072c993.name: fold_address_into_indirection
0x1072c993.comment: for IL indirect operand 0x14c: if pointer temp is defined by add base,const or lea [..] fold base/index/scale/disp into the memory operand (0x14d/0x14c) when regs not redefined

0x1072ccac.name: enforce_two_address_form
0x1072ccac.comment: dst = src0 op src1: ties dst to src0 temp when single-def, else inserts mov copy before.

0x1072ccd9.name: tie_dest_to_source_temp
0x1072ccd9.comment: Makes the dest temp share the source temp register descriptor along a copy chain.

0x1072cd9e.name: get_tied_source_operand
0x1072cd9e.comment: Which source is tied to the destination (0x166 multi-op, 0x178, compare-like ops -> first; else matching temp).

0x1072cdec.name: sizeopt_branch_operands
0x1072cdec.comment: Width analysis for compares feeding conditional branches.

0x1072d139.name: try_if_convert_diamond
0x1072d139.comment: Pattern if(c) x=a; else x=b; (IL 0x15b copies or 0x16c return value in both arms) -> single IL 0x18f select tuple, deletes arms.

0x1072d549.name: eliminate_compare_with_zero
0x1072d549.comment: cmp t,0: walks back to the flag-setting def of t; if its flags are valid for the jcc (per-opcode tables 0x1072d8f0/0x1072d900) the cmp is deleted; an and whose result is otherwise dead becomes test.

0x1072db07.name: op_supports_width
0x1072db07.comment: Opcode-specific width legality (mov/cmp/and constants must fit; and->16-bit disabled under /Ot).

0x1072dc51.name: find_rmw_dest_in_expr
0x1072dc51.comment: Recursive search of the add/sub expression tree for the destination operand (sets 0x1079f198 when found under a subtraction).

0x1072dd9c.name: tuple_replace
0x1072dd9c.comment: Insert new tuple (edx) before old (ecx), then unlink+free old.

0x1072de84.name: lower_call_site
0x1072de84.comment: call IL: register args (fastcall/thiscall via 0x1072c01b), /GZ __chkesp, stack cleanup (0x1072df42), arg copies -> push (0x1072e095), clobbers (0x10702a2c)

0x1072df42.name: emit_call_stack_cleanup
0x1072df42.comment: conv 0 or 0x40 (caller-pop) and callee not flagged 0x80: add esp,N after call; else record N in call +0x20 (callee pops, ret N)

0x1072dfd5.name: sum_call_arg_bytes
0x1072dfd5.comment: sum of stack bytes of call args, each rounded to 0x107ac0f4

0x1072e095.name: convert_arg_copies_to_push
0x1072e095.comment: 0x15a arg copy -> push (opcode 0xd), float 0x15a deleted (stored via fstp), 0x16a struct -> 0x1072e210, 0x190 deleted

0x1072e1eb.name: operand_new_regset
0x1072e1eb.comment: Kind-0xa symbol-set operand (op 0x158), +0x14 = bitset of symbol ids (clobbers).

0x1072e201.name: note_call_target_frame
0x1072e201.comment: if 0x1079903c != -1: 0x1076ea17 bookkeeping for non-special call targets

0x1072e210.name: lower_arg_push_value
0x1072e210.comment: 2-byte args widened to dword push (temp/symbol if 0x1072ab94, const if /Ot); 8-byte args split into two pushes

0x1072e390.name: bind_result_to_register
0x1072e390.comment: Assigns a tuple's result to a physical register descriptor (e.g. ST0 0x107ad15c, EAX 0x107ac784), storing to memory dest when needed

0x1072e7cb.name: insert_upward_exposed_reloads
0x1072e7cb.comment: Per block forward, avail = live-in (+0x40), pending persists across blocks: a use of an unavailable candidate inserts a 0x163 reload (0x107249b8); a def or reload sets pending; a use while available clears it; a def/reload while pending, and every candidate still pending and not live-out at block end (pending &= ~live-out +0x44), goes to demote_unused_candidate_def 0x107318e5. Records the last def/reload at cand info+0x10 and the def count at +8.

0x1072ed0d.name: compute_reaching_def_webs
0x1072ed0d.comment: color.c: numbers definitions per candidate symbol and unions defs reaching common uses into webs (0x1073168d); returns number of def numbers.

0x1072f55d.name: create_web_live_ranges
0x1072f55d.comment: For every web of every candidate symbol creates one live range (0x10723758) and maps def numbers -> range; drops unused constant ranges.

0x1072f8fc.name: choose_frame_pointer_mode
0x1072f8fc.comment: Before global colouring: FPO (0x10) if /Oy and no flags 0xc1/0x10000 and no SEH; /Og+/Ot FP functions may get 8-aligned frame (0x600000) by weighted double-access score.

0x1072fb58.name: global_color_registers
0x1072fb58.comment: color.c driver: coalesce, forward-subst, x87 fold, frame decision, per class (x87 first, then int): pressure, score, prune, queue, colour loop; then rewrite.

0x1072fef2.name: fold_x87_copy_sequences
0x1072fef2.comment: Append (read): runs from allocate_x87_live_ranges after allocation. For FSTP m2 whose previous tuple is FLD m (memory source, same operand type, /Ot or type 0x4004, no +0x2c operand flags), the FLD becomes MOV m2,m via emit_float_move_as_integer and the FSTP is freed. Otherwise x87_keep_float_temp_on_stack(t) finds the defining tuple. An 8-byte result goes through lower_int64_tuple. A copy whose value is an x87 candidate (inline float parameter) is not folded, so it stays in the ST0 chain (player_update p3).

0x10730253.name: x87_stack_effect
0x10730253.comment: Push/pop delta (-2..+1) of an FP tuple; calls: fp results minus fp args.

0x10730308.name: coalesce_copy_live_ranges
0x10730308.comment: Collects the copies mov lrD, lrS (one src and one dst operand, both kind-1 live ranges, source not a constant; lr+0x24 counts definitions here). If lrD has one definition, lrD is merged into lrS unless has_intervening_base_definition(S symbol, copy, end of lrD) finds S redefined while lrD is live. Otherwise, if lrS has one definition and that definition is the tuple just before the copy, lrS is renamed to lrD. The copy is deleted. Verified: projectile_render's `projectile = t` (t = the IV-merge lea at the loop head) disappears between the dumps at 0x10730308 and 0x107306c1. Read and verified.

0x107306c1.name: forward_substitute_single_def_ranges
0x107306c1.comment: Ranges with one simple def (mov from memory / lea of ranges) whose inputs are unchanged at uses are substituted into the uses and freed; lr+5 bit 4 = not substitutable. Phase 1 excludes value uses (except a /Ot register copy back into the lea's own source), uses before the definition, a second definition with another tree, and unfoldable definitions (is_foldable_address_definition / is_substitutable_address_use). Phase 2 calls has_intervening_base_definition for the base (and index); any store or call of alias class 1 in the live stretch blocks substitution. This, not globopt or pass_select_address_modes, is where a named field pointer is folded into [base+disp]. Verified (fsub_trace.py).

0x107309bb.comment: Forward-substitution eligibility of a range definition (ECX = tuple): LEA (opcode 0x12) with one destination and a kind-5 source. 0x14c base+disp: foldable when the base live range has kind 2. 0x14f index*s+disp: with /Ot, when the index range has kind 2. 0x14d base+index*s+disp: with /Ot, when both have kind 2. 0x14e sym+index and 0x14a &sym+disp: never (a named pointer to global[i].field survives phase 1). Read; the 0x14e case verified (player_update target_position).

0x1073168d.name: merge_defs_into_web

0x107318e5.name: demote_unused_candidate_def

0x107318e5.comment: Undoes the pending def/reload recorded at candidate info+0x10 when it was never used as a register: a 0x163 reload is freed (uses read memory), a constant load is reverted to immediates, a dead single-def temp is deleted, a local's def gets operand_make_sym (becomes a memory store). Called from insert_upward_exposed_reloads on a second def/reload while pending (0x1072e8ef, 0x1072ea89) and at block end for every candidate still pending and not live-out (0x1072eb81, where=0). Trace-verified: all byte stores of a bool passed to a bool param are demoted here (constant-candidates.md).

0x10731a50.name: has_intervening_base_definition
0x10731a50.comment: Walks backward from the range end (arg3) to the definition (arg2). A live flag starts at 1. At each block marker (kind 0x19) it is reloaded from the block bitset at +0x44 of [marker+0x14]+4, and a definition of the range itself clears it. Only tuples walked while the flag is set are checked. It returns 1 when a destination operand has the same parent symbol as the base (arg1->sym+8), with the same symbol or an overlapping offset, or an alias class that contains it (kinds 2/3). Verified effect: a lea range whose value is used after the loop is walked across the latch's IV increment and returns 1 (projectile_render ion pointer). Read, and traced through frame_predict --decisions.

0x10731bbf.name: is_substitutable_address_use

Otherwise it finds the use's memory operand (find_mem_operand_using). It accepts a 0x14c use, or any use when the definition is 0x14f and the use has no scale bits, and rejects when both the definition and the use carry an index. Read.

0x10731dae.name: recompute_last_use_flags

0x10732001.name: handle_unprofitable_live_range

0x10732216.name: build_interference_and_pressure_splits

0x10733230.name: propagate_colour_to_neighbours

0x10733569.name: build_colour_queue

0x10733655.prototype: c2_tuple* __fastcall tuple_move_range(c2_tuple* pos, c2_tuple* first, c2_tuple* last)

0x10733683.name: tuple_clobbers_branch_operand

0x107336f4.name: local_color_registers

0x107337ec.name: split_memory_operands_g5
0x107337ec.comment: /Og+/Ot: per block backward, RMW/cmp/test/push with a memory operand gets 'mov reg,[mem]' via rotating cursor (reset each block).

0x10733b7b.name: stack_frame_layout_pass
0x10733b7b.comment: stack.c:117. -ZI/-ZX -> ENC layout; !/Og, fsym flag 0x1000(SEH), -dlp or (EH 0x10000 && !/GX) -> assign_temp_homes_in_reference_order; else pack_frame_locals.

0x10733bf8.comment: Optimized layout: init, count refs, index, FPO size check, liveness, interference, pack_stack_slots(fn, fpo_or_aligned, nsyms).

0x10733d67.name: init_frame_layout_state
0x10733d67.comment: Zero packer globals, clear 'homed' bit on autos, frame cursor=0, preallocate EH record (0x10799020) and !/GX node 0x1079bd90 first, collect params.

0x10733e59.name: clear_auto_home_flag_cb
0x10733e59.comment: Symbol callback: kind 1 storage 0x10 (auto) -> clear +0x14 bit 0x800 so it is re-homed.

0x10733e75.name: count_stack_object_references
0x10733e75.comment: Runs inside stack_frame_layout_pass (after global/local colouring and G5 splits, before prolog, jump optimizer, finlower, block mover, scheduler). Blocks in list order, tuples forward, src list then dst list. Kinds 2/3 -> sym->parent +1; kinds 5/6 with direct symbol (+0x20) -> parent +1; kind 11 memory effects expand to alias-class members ONLY when the tuple kind is 0x15 (inline asm, IL op 0x191) - calls add nothing. Classes 3/4/5 only; no loop weighting. Verified by observer replay on 1,833 objects and ctl_main/ctl_asm controls.

0x10733fbe.name: index_stack_objects
0x10733fbe.comment: Build array 0x1079f218 in list order, set +0x38 index, params into bitset 0x1079f214, count params (0x1079f21c), sum sizes (0x1079f22c).

0x10734011.name: choose_fpo_for_size
0x10734011.comment: /Os only: if FPO and ebp not used as a register, drop FPO when esp-relative frame refs exceed 1 (function has locals) or 4 (no locals).

0x1073404f.name: generate_prolog_epilog
0x1073404f.comment: MDmisc.c:1558. push ebp/mov ebp,esp [and esp,-8], EH prolog, sub esp or __chkstk, /GZ fill, callee-saved pushes; epilog mirrors; ret N.

0x10734647.name: shrink_wrap_callee_saves
0x10734647.comment: /Og: dataflow places push/pop of callee-saved regs around the blocks that use them; returns mask of regs handled (skipped by entry push).

0x10734f8b.name: emit_callee_saved_pushes
0x10734f8b.comment: Order ebx, ebp, esi, edi (reg 4..8) when in 0x10799014 mask and descriptor +5 bit 0x10 (dirty) and not shrink-wrapped.

0x10734fdd.name: tuple_find_prev_of_kind

0x10734ff3.name: emit_callee_saved_pops

0x10735042.name: jump_optimize
0x10735042.comment:
Repeats jump_optimize_sweep until no change, at most 17 sweeps. Called at 0x10758466
(unless fn+0x34&0x800, cross-jumping off) and 0x107584a9 (/Og, full).

0x10735067.name: jump_optimize_sweep
0x10735067.comment:
One forward sweep; dispatch on kind: ret/switch -> dead code, branch -> threading/inversion/
cross-jump, label -> merge/thread/cross-jump/tail sink. Restart point after a change: jump_opt_restart_point.

0x1073536c.name: final_lowering_peepholes
0x1073536c.comment: finlower.c:232. Size/speed peepholes: push ecx for sub esp,4; pop ecx; xor/or -1; inc/dec; lea->add/shl; tail calls; x87 fst/fcomp merges; sahf->test ah.

0x107365d8.name: delete_identity_alu_op

0x1073663c.name: block_mover
0x1073663c.comment:
Loop1: jmp J->L over a region [J->next..L->prev] that ends in jmp/ret: move region after first
jmp/ret after L, delete J. Loop2: pull single-entry target block to jump site or duplicate small block.

0x10736ab0.name: remove_unreachable_after_terminators
0x10736ab0.comment: Late pass: delete_unreachable_after for every ret/jmp; 0x18c markers mark their label's refs.

0x10736b27.name: late_register_value_cse
0x10736b27.comment:
/Og: per extended block tracks register<->value (reg copies, memory, constants) and replaces
redundant loads/moves with registers; resets at labels.

0x107374aa.name: schedule_instructions
0x107374aa.comment:
schedmd.c list scheduler over windows between prologue-end (0x1b4) and 0x1b1; arg2=0 integer
mode (only mode reached from the driver).

0x107375d6.name: sched_should_run
0x107375d6.comment: fp_mode 0 -> 1; fp_mode 1 needs /Ot, fn+0x34&8, cpu not G4/G6, !0x107ac118, !(fn+0x34&1).

0x107375e4.name: sched_graph_alloc
0x107375e4.comment: arena 4, 0x38-byte graph, node size 0x3c, edge size 0x18; stores edge/node callbacks.

0x1073761e.name: sched_init_cpu_model

0x10737743.name: sched_release_prologue_epilogue
0x10737743.comment:
Moves prologue-end marker up to just after the last frame-setup insn (push ebp/mov ebp,esp/
sub esp/and esp,-8/push ecx/enter), releasing <=10 tuples; same for epilogue-begin marker.

0x107379e0.name: function_stores_to_stack_symbol
0x107379e0.comment: Scans for a real tuple whose destination is a kind-2 stack symbol of class 3/4/6 (used for sub esp rule).

0x10737a43.name: sched_find_window_end
0x10737a43.comment: Window ends at first branch/switch/label (inclusive), before 0x1b5 or end marker, or after 81 nodes.

0x10737a97.name: sched_window_worth_scheduling
0x10737a97.comment: True if the window does not start at 0x1b5 and has >= 2 tuples with operands (flags bit 0) before its last node; the last node is not counted, so a cmp;jcc window is left unscheduled. (fp_mode path 0x1077abe5 is dead.)

0x10737ad8.name: tuple_encoded_length
0x10737ad8.comment: Encodes into a 0x40-byte scratch buffer and returns the length.

0x10737aee.name: encode_instruction
0x10737aee.prototype: int __fastcall encode_instruction(c2_tuple *t, uint8_t *buf, int a3, int a4, int a5)
0x10737aee.comment:
code.c table-driven x86 encoder: tries up to 6 forms per opcode (0x107a1e5c bytes,
0x107a25fc form codes) and takes the first form whose operand constraints match.

0x107384c2.name: assign_source_operand_registers
0x107384c2.comment: Temp sources get holder register (subregister by size); holder freed unless the tuple also redefines the temp; explicit-register sources free their slot.

0x1073855d.name: assign_destination_operand_registers

0x107386bb.name: emit_value_bytes
0x107386bb.comment: Writes a value of the given byte size to the encode cursor.

0x10738715.name: encode_imm_or_disp
0x10738715.comment:
Emits immediate/displacement; with sign-extension allowed and 0x146 constant fitting imm8
emits 1 byte and returns 2 (s-bit).

0x107388f3.name: rewrite_live_range_operands
0x107388f3.comment: Deletes split markers and redundant 0x164 stores, replaces kind-2 homes by (sub)register descriptors, turns 0x163/0x164 into mov.

0x10738a4a.name: encode_modrm

0x10738c8a.name: compute_local_conflicts_backward
0x10738c8a.comment: Per block backward from busy-at-exit: temp live across def of explicit/global reg or call clobber conflicts with it; byte temps vs esi/edi/ebp; prefs from mov to/from a register; marks regs used; constant-register scores.

0x107392c7.name: x87_block_fxch_scheduling
0x107392c7.comment: Called from local regalloc; only /Ot and fn uses FP (flag 8): per block simulate+rewrite+restore.

0x1073932c.name: cache_loop_memory_base

0x107395e3.name: finalize_callee_saved_registers
0x107395e3.comment: Undo registers holding only constants with net score<=2; /Os: move ebp use to unused ebx, else esi, else edi.

0x10739688.name: sched_graph_reset
0x10739688.comment: Frees all nodes/edges of the window graph.

0x107396f6.name: sched_build_dependency_graph
0x107396f6.comment:
dag.c: one node per tuple, register RAW/WAR/WAW and memory edges, barriers for control
tuples, calls, cli/sti/0x166 and volatile operands; root edges flag 0x80000.

0x10739a01.name: sched_dag_reset_state
0x10739a01.comment: Clears reg/mem access lists and node/edge counters.

0x10739a2d.name: sched_new_node
0x10739a2d.comment: Creates node: seq(+0x36)=creation index, tuple(+0x1c), mem read/write bits, unit class, latency.

0x10739aea.name: tuple_reads_memory
0x10739aea.comment: Any source operand of kind 6 or 2.

0x10739b0d.name: tuple_writes_memory
0x10739b0d.comment: Any destination operand of kind 6 or 2.

0x10739b58.name: sched_node_latency
0x10739b58.comment: latency_table[dst op].+0 + sched_latency_adjust; opcodes >= 0x144 (IL pseudo ops such as 0x162) get only the adjustment.

0x10739b8a.name: sched_latency_adjust
0x10739b8a.comment: Extra cycles for memory operands, RMW, 16/32-bit mul/div forms.

0x10739c44.name: tuple_reads_sources
0x10739c44.comment: False for fxch and xor r,r (zero idiom) so no source dependences are added.

0x10739c80.name: sched_add_source_deps
0x10739c80.comment: Adds RAW (flag 1) register and memory (0x20) edges for sources.

0x10739d02.name: sched_add_dest_deps
0x10739d02.comment: Adds WAW(4)/WAR(2) register and memory store (0x80/0x40) edges for destinations.

0x10739e8d.name: sched_deps_on_prior_defs
0x10739e8d.comment: Edges from prior defs overlapping an operand; RAW edges get latency via sched_set_edge_latency.

0x10739f94.name: sched_record_access
0x10739f94.comment: Prepends an access record to a list.

0x1073a05b.name: sched_mark_call_arg_edge
0x1073a05b.comment: Sets edge +0x14=2 for call-argument stores (fp-return functions, non-G6).

0x1073a0fd.name: pick_g5_split_register
0x1073a0fd.comment: From cursor+1 over order list: first pass registers already used (+5 bit 0x10), second any, byte_only restricts to regs<=4; updates cursor.

0x1073a21a.name: sched_add_or_merge_edge
0x1073a21a.comment: Reuses an existing from->to edge (ORs flags) or adds one.

0x1073a24d.name: sched_find_edge
0x1073a24d.comment: Finds existing edge from->to in to's in-list.

0x1073a261.name: sched_set_edge_latency
0x1073a261.comment: Latency = producer latency (+0x38) + CPU-specific penalties (AGI etc); 0x162 producers -> 0.

0x1073a2de.name: sched_is_esp_push_pop_chain
0x1073a2de.comment: For the esp register (not on G6): returns 1 when producer and consumer are both push (0xd/0xba) or both pop (0xc/0xb9) with no +0x3a flags; sched_set_edge_latency then sets the edge latency to 0 on G5. Verified: push->push esp edges (kind 7) have latency 0 in player_update.

0x1073a363.name: sched_agi_penalty
0x1073a363.comment: G5/G4 term of sched_set_edge_latency: returns 1 when the producer's destination register is the base or index of a memory operand of the consumer (address generation interlock); esp with push/pop/call has special cases (can return 2). Verified: shl eax,2 -> mov [eax+disp],ebx edge latency 2 in player_update.

0x1073a42e.name: sched_fp_store_latency_penalty
0x1073a42e.comment: G5 (cpu index 2) term of sched_set_edge_latency: returns 1 when the consumer is fst/fstp (0x62/0x63, not fxch) and the producer is fadd/fsub/fmul (0x45-0x47) or fld (0x60). So fmul -> fstp edges get latency 3+1 = 4. A FROUND (0x162) between them removes the penalty (FROUND -> fstp latency 0) but the FROUND takes its own cycle. Verified in the player_update sched trace (fmul->fstp s289 latency 4; fmul->FROUND 3; FROUND->fstp 0).

0x1073a471.name: sched_memory_deps_on_stores
0x1073a471.comment: Edges from prior stores that may alias (operands_may_alias / 0x1071d500). Observed edge kinds: 0x20 store->later load, 0x40 load->later store, 0x80 store->later store (kinds OR with register kinds, e.g. 0x41).

0x1073a4d4.name: sched_set_output_dep_latency
0x1073a4d4.comment: WAW (kind 4) edges from sched_deps_on_prior_defs: raises edge latency to the per-CPU minimum (short table 0x107a2de0[cpu]) unless the producer is a call (kind 0xe), the consumer is fxch (0x5f), the register is cc (g_reg_symbols[0x42]), the producer is a 0x162 round marker, or 0x1073a2de(reg, edge) returns nonzero (not decoded).

0x1073a531.name: sched_record_memory_access
0x1073a531.comment: Appends a memory access record to load/store lists.

0x1073a59a.name: sched_make_barrier
0x1073a59a.comment: All sink nodes get an order edge (0x80000) to the barrier; memory lists flushed.

0x1073a684.name: sched_compute_priorities
0x1073a684.comment: height = max(succ.height+edge latency)+1; priority = sum shift_signed(term, weight) over feeds-jcc, height, out_degree, critical, reads_mem, plus writes_mem only when the tuple type class is 0x4000 (float store bonus). /G5: height<<13 + reads_mem<<16 + float_store<<16 + out_degree>>5; verified against traced priorities.

0x1073a849.name: sched_mark_branch_feeders
0x1073a849.comment: If window ends in jcc/jecxz: its flag producers get +0x39 bit7 (weight 23 on G6, 0 on G5).

0x1073a91f.name: sched_fp_adjust_edges
0x1073a91f.comment: Runs in integer mode whenever the function uses FP (0x10799254 = fn+0x34 bit 3), not only in the dead fp_mode. For 0x162 FROUND nodes calls sched_bypass_round_marker_edges; for other float tuples adds RAW edges (read, not trace-verified) between float tuples sharing a value parent (loop 0x1073a9ed).

0x1073a9fb.name: sched_break_dep_by_displacement
0x1073a9fb.comment:
Marks RAW/WAR edges between add/sub/inc/dec/lea/push of a base register and memory users of it
as bypassable (edge +0x16 kind), so the user can move across with an adjusted displacement.

0x1073af90.name: sched_list_schedule
0x1073af90.comment:
Cycle-driven top-down list scheduling: each cycle select up to issue-width ready nodes in ready
order, emit them, release successors.

0x1073b107.name: sched_edge_satisfied
0x1073b107.comment: Decrements to.+0x20 (and +0x24 for bypassable edges); node ready when +0x20 == +0x24.

0x1073b147.name: sched_ready_insert
0x1073b147.comment: Ready list sorted by +0x2c priority descending, ties by +0x36 seq ascending (source order).

0x1073b176.name: sched_select_cycle
0x1073b176.comment:
Walks ready list in order; accepts first nodes whose unit is free and earliest cycle fits;
applies displacement rewrites (0x10751ea0) for bypassed preds.

0x1073b368.name: sched_dynamic_priority
0x1073b368.comment: Dynamic priority update; returns immediately in integer mode (weight[4] = -2 on all CPUs).

0x1073b3e0.name: sched_pick_unit_p5
0x1073b3e0.comment:
G3/G5 unit picker: class>=unit count -> whole cycle; first slot needs units c and c+1;
second slot needs U/V pairing (sched_can_pair_uv).

0x1073b4a8.name: sched_defer_for_bypassed_pred
0x1073b4a8.comment: Non-G6: defer a node if a bypassable pred will be ready next cycle (avoid rewrite).

0x1073b500.name: sched_fxch_hold
0x1073b500.comment: /Ot G5: after fxch prefer a float op that pairs; else hold.

0x1073b53e.name: sched_ready_remove
0x1073b53e.comment: Unlinks node from the ready list.

0x1073b597.name: sched_can_pair_uv
0x1073b597.comment:
Pentium pairing: first op UV/PU (table+8 word 0 or 0x100), second UV/PV (0 or 0x200);
